content.value_statement: FastAPI teams often repeat router setup, authentication wiring, response models, and status code choices. This skill guides consistent router creation from an existing project pattern.
actual_capabilities: Guides creation of FastAPI router modules from a template.
Shows optional and required authentication dependency patterns.
Demonstrates response_model usage for single items and lists.
Recommends HTTP status codes for create and delete routes.
Lists integration steps for routers, models, services, and frontend API functions.
limitations: Does not include the referenced template.py asset in this package.
Does not generate database models, migrations, or service logic by itself.
Requires project-specific validation before production use.
Does not verify framework versions or local authentication helpers.

use_cases.title: Add Resource Endpoints
use_cases.description: Create a new router for a domain resource with consistent naming, authentication, and response models.

use_cases.title: Standardize API Patterns
use_cases.description: Align route structure and HTTP status behavior across a FastAPI codebase.

use_cases.title: Review Router Requirements
use_cases.description: Check that planned endpoints include models, auth dependencies, service boundaries, and frontend integration steps.

prompt_templates.title: Create Basic Router
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a FastAPI router for a Project resource using required authentication, response models, and clear HTTP status codes.

prompt_templates.title: Add Auth Variants
prompt_templates.prompt: Design Project router endpoints that use optional auth for listing and required auth for create, update, and delete.

prompt_templates.title: Match Existing Patterns
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the existing routers as reference and create a matching FastAPI router for Project with Pydantic response models.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Full Integration
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan the router, Pydantic models, service layer, main.py mounting, and frontend API functions for a Project resource.

output_examples.input: Create a router for projects with list, get, create, and delete endpoints.
output_examples.output: A router plan with endpoint names, authentication requirements, response models, and expected status codes.

output_examples.input: Review my FastAPI router plan before implementation.
output_examples.output: A checklist covering router placement, main application mounting, models, service layer needs, and frontend API updates.

best_practices: Confirm the project authentication helpers before adding dependencies.
Define Pydantic response models before wiring route decorators.
Use explicit status codes for create and delete operations.
anti_patterns: Creating routers without mounting them in the main application.
Returning untyped data instead of response models.
Mixing service logic directly into route handlers without a project reason.

faq.question: Does this skill create a complete API feature?
faq.answer: No. It guides router structure and integration steps, but service logic and validation remain project-specific.

faq.question: Can it support required authentication?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill shows required authentication through a FastAPI dependency pattern.

faq.question: Can it support optional authentication?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill shows an optional dependency pattern that returns no user when unauthenticated.

faq.question: Does it include a template file?
faq.answer: No. The instructions mention a template path, but only SKILL.md is present in this package.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists compatibility with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Should generated routers be tested?
faq.answer: Yes. Validate imports, authentication behavior, response models, and status codes in the target project.
